_comment: Felt: wool beaten and rolled rather than spun and woven. It is the fabric of a people who follow their flock - it needs no loom, it is made in a day, and it is what a tent is (D100).
name: felt
label: Felt

_comment: Smoked over a slow fire, meat keeps a season instead of a week. It is the northern answer to a winter with no grain in it.
name: smoked_meat
label: Smoked meat
